description: This file defines classes and enums related to error injection for storage providers in Orleans, including mechanisms to simulate errors at specific points during storage operations for testing purposes.

classes.name: ErrorInjectionPoint
classes.description: Enumeration representing points in storage operations where errors can be injected.

classes.name: ErrorInjectionBehavior
classes.description: Struct defining the behavior for error injection, including the exception type and injection point.

classes.name: StorageProviderInjectedError
classes.description: Custom exception class used to simulate errors injected into storage provider operations.

classes.name: ErrorInjectionStorageProvider
classes.description: A mock storage provider that can inject errors at specified points for testing, implementing IControllable.

methods.name: SetErrorInjection
methods.description: Static method to set error injection behavior on a specific provider via management grain.

methods.name: SetErrorInjection
methods.description: Instance method to set the current error injection behavior.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Overrides the close method to reset error injection and handle cleanup.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Overrides reading state to potentially inject errors before and after the operation.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Overrides writing state to potentially inject errors before and after the operation.

methods.name: ThrowIfMatches
methods.description: Checks if the current error injection point matches the specified point and throws the configured exception.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes control commands, such as setting error injection behavior.
